Hi all 

Thanks for the forward, Marissa, and thanks Amy for the files. A few clarifications and next steps from engineering/security side: 

- Reviewed redwood_subprocessors_20270625.csv: summary below (short answers you can share with infosec):
  * AWS (us-west-2)  primary inference and KV caches. Hosts customer model runtime and token streams. Data at rest encrypted using AWS KMS managed keys (customer-managed KMS available on Dedicated/Private plans).
  * GCP  analytics pipelines only; we only send aggregated telemetry and anonymized job metrics. No persistent customer PII stored in GCP analytics projects.
  * Datadog  monitoring + metrics. Only metadata and uptime/latency metrics; no customer prompt/response payloads.

- SOC2: the summary looks good. For full report requests we typically initiate an NDA and a controlled share via secure portal. We can commit to quarterly evidence refresh cadence for enterprise contracts.

- Vendor questionnaire: I filled high-level answers in the attached doc (redwood_vendor_security_questionnaire_v1.docx) and added comments where technical detail might be required. Notes: encryption-at-rest is KMS; encryption-in-transit is TLS1.2+; KV cache retention is configurable per-customer; we can provide architecture diagrams on request.

Next steps: 
- Marissa/Neha: please share any specific questionnaire fields Acme must see answered verbatim and I'll expand the technical responses.
- Amy/Jared: if possible, send the vendor questionnaire PDF or Doc (or a link to your portal). Rishi will finish the detailed responses once we see their exact questions.

Happy to jump on a follow-up call next week if that speeds things up.


Rishi Malhotra
Staff Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0345
